claim_boundary: This audit selects one packaging-contract fix, records three capabilities already present on the delivery mainline, and classifies the remaining reviewed branch work as rejected, future independent reimplementation, rewrite, or frozen evidence. An already-absorbed classification requires no cherry-pick; a frozen or future classification grants no mainline capability. The inventory and decisions do not establish numerical, generation, API, timing, performance, release, or production authority.

decision_vocabulary.selected: the exact commit is retained on the consolidation mainline
decision_vocabulary.already_absorbed: the required capability is already present through a named mainline commit, so the archive commit is not cherry-picked
decision_vocabulary.rejected: the reviewed candidate has no remaining mainline absorption action
decision_vocabulary.future_independent_reimplementation: the product idea may be useful, but the archived implementation is not imported and must be independently scoped and verified on the then-current mainline
decision_vocabulary.rewrite: the archived harness is not imported; a successor must be written against the current owning contract
decision_vocabulary.frozen: the branch remains a recovery or evidence reference and is not merged wholesale
